description: Quadrature low-frequency oscillator — one wave shape at four phases, 0, 90, 180 and 270 degrees

params.text: Calibrated in volts; 0V is 2.04Hz. V/OCT is added to it
Selects the wave; all four outputs carry the same shape
One knob doing two jobs, whichever the selected wave calls for: pulse width on the square, and sampling — stepping the output — on the rest. CV at S/PW
Smoothing: a slew limiter applied last, after offset and scale
An offset added to the outputs; SCL scales them before the offset is added. A CV each
The phase of that output, in degrees from the fundamental, with a CV alongside

inputs.text: One knob doing two jobs, whichever the selected wave calls for: pulse width on the square, and sampling — stepping the output — on the rest. CV at S/PW
Smoothing: a slew limiter applied last, after offset and scale
An offset added to the outputs; SCL scales them before the offset is added. A CV each
Calibrated in volts; 0V is 2.04Hz. V/OCT is added to it
The phase of that output, in degrees from the fundamental, with a CV alongside

outputs.text: The wave at the phase set by its own PHS knob

notes: on the stepped random wave all four outputs draw from one sequence, so they differ in phase and not in value
menu: Offset range — sets what the OFFSET control covers, +/-5V or +/-10V
